notes: Small additive creator-revision build. Safety Tracker now records which controlled document or Toolbox Talk was created from each in-app creator draft. For SSWs created inside Safety Tracker, Managers can choose Edit in app -> new version from Document details or directly from the linked RA/COSHH impact screen. The existing SSW questionnaire is cloned into a revision draft, the version number is advanced automatically, and the Manager can amend only what changed. Generate/import then creates a pending replacement version on the same SSW record; the approved current version remains in use and remains in history until the replacement is approved. External/uploaded SSWs continue to use the normal replacement-PDF route. This build also links new creator imports to their created document/TBT so future revision workflows are reliable. Supabase migration creator_revision_links_v21058 applied. In-app TBT editing, refresher-method controls and ad-hoc retraining remain separate next builds. Includes v2.10.57 and earlier fixes.
